description: This file defines a Java interface named DataResourceWorkerInterface, which declares a method for rendering data resources as text with specified parameters; it resides in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.content package and is part of the Ofbiz framework's widget content module.

classes.name: DataResourceWorkerInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for rendering data resources to text, potentially with caching and localization support.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders a data resource identified by dataResourceId into text form, using provided context, locale, MIME type, and cache flag. May throw GeneralException or IOException.
